title: Strength, Four Lifts
summary: Four days, one main lift each: squat, bench, deadlift, press. One heavy top set, then lighter back-off sets.
author: Spotter

phases.name: Build
phases.note: Moderate loads, clean reps. Add weight whenever the top set reaches the top of its range.

phases.name: Heavy
phases.note: Fewer reps, heavier top sets. Long rests. Stop a set the moment bar speed dies.

effort.text: Leave 2 to 3 reps in the tank. No grinding
Stop 1 to 2 reps short of failure
